missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Очко' is the neuter nominative subject of 'решило', which agrees in the neuter. 'Это' agrees in the neuter, and 'весь матч' is the accusative object. A dramatic sports moment.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Очко' is the accusative direct object of 'заработала'; neuter, so it matches the nominative. 'Одно' agrees in the neuter accusative. A core scoring pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive of shortage. 'Очка' is the genitive form governed by 'не хватает'. 'Одного' agrees in the neuter genitive, and 'нам' is the dative experiencer. A tense competition pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Очком' is the instrumental case showing the measure used. 'Каждым' agrees in the neuter instrumental. A reflective statement about scoring.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В очке' uses the prepositional form 'очке' after 'в' to locate the difference. 'Вся разница' is the nominative subject. A figurative but natural statement.
Strategic focus: Dative after a verb. 'Очку' is the dative case governed by 'радуйся', which takes the dative. 'Набранному' is the agreeing neuter dative participle. An encouraging sports phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Очков' is the genitive plural governed by 'много'. 'Сегодня' sets the time. Note the fleeting-vowel genitive plural ending. Good for plural practice.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Очки' is the nominative plural subject of the short adjective 'важны'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'нам' is the dative experiencer. Good for plural agreement.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Очка' is the genitive form after 'без', expressing the absence of the point. 'Этого' agrees in the neuter genitive. A conditional warning pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative comparison. 'Очко' stays nominative as the subject. 'Это' agrees in the neuter, and 'ценнее остальных' uses the genitive plural 'остальных' in a comparison. Strong for comparative practice.
